main_text.l: DISPUTATIO TEXTUALIS.
Theologica ex Joh. 3. v. 5.
De REGENERATIONE.
Ἐὰν μὴ τις γεννηθῇ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ πνεύματος, οὐ δύναται εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
THESIS I.
ΕΝΟΣ δὲ χρεία[?]: sic respondit olim Christus Jesus
Servator noster Marthæ, Luc. 10. v. 41. quæ suprà
modum sollicita erat, & de multis satagebat, taci-
tè eam arguens τῆς πολυπραγμοσύνης[?], dùm ipsi non multa,
sed unum ostendit, de quo debeat esse sollicita, nempè re-
gnum cœlorum, unum necessarium, quo qui fruitur, omnia
possidet, qui verò caret, omnibus caret: & quemadmo-
dum regnum cælorum unum illud est, ad quod assequen-
dum tendere debemus, ita unum est medium eò nos du-
cens, nempè Christus Jesus cum suis beneficiis, ex quorum
primis est Regeneratio, de cujus necessitate ad regnum Dei
consequendum Christus ipse Nicodemo concionatur, tùm
in toto contextu, tùm in hoc ipso textu; cujus considerabi-
mus occasionem, scopum & argumentum.

page.notes: Thesis heading "THESIS I." is set as a level 2 heading because it stands alone in spaced capitals. The Greek epigraph and the Greek phrases in the first paragraph are doubtful in places (marked [?]), notably the accent and iota-subscript forms and the word πολυπραγμοσύνης. The drop-cap E of the first paragraph is joined to ΕΝΟΣ. The marginal text on both sides is show-through and was left out.
